failure_modes.mode: Micro-reactor blockage due to precipitate formation
failure_modes.cause: Low flow rate (0.087 mL/min) and long residence time (122 min) increase probability of nucleation/crystallization of product or byproducts in 0.75 mm ID tubing, especially if local supersaturation occurs.
failure_modes.mitigation: Implement in-line filtration or ultrasonic agitation; optimize solvent composition to maintain solubility; add pressure sensor upstream to detect blockage early.

failure_modes.mode: Pressure integrity failure due to insufficient safety margin
failure_modes.cause: Operating pressure (2.0 bar) is only ~1.3 bar above acetonitrile vapor pressure at 50°C. Pressure spikes from pump pulsation or minor blockages could cause cavitation or exceed safe operating limits if not buffered.
failure_modes.mitigation: Increase back-pressure regulation to minimum 3.0 bar as recommended; install pressure relief valve; use pulse-dampening pump.

failure_modes.mode: Thermal runaway due to poor heat transfer in long coil
failure_modes.cause: Although Da_thermal is low, the 24 m coil length creates significant thermal mass. If cooling fails, exothermic condensation reaction could accumulate heat, especially with laminar flow (Re=5) limiting convective cooling.
failure_modes.mitigation: Ensure redundant cooling system; monitor temperature at multiple points along coil; design for passive heat dissipation.

single_points_of_failure: Single pump failure stops entire process
BPR valve failure leads to pressure loss or overpressure
Single temperature control loop for entire 24 m coil
validation_experiments: Run 72-hour continuous operation with in-line pressure and temperature monitoring to assess blockage risk and thermal stability
Perform pressure spike test by rapidly increasing flow rate to 2x nominal to evaluate system response and safety margins
Conduct solubility study of product/byproducts in acetonitrile at 50°C under static conditions for 122 minutes to predict precipitation risk
